description.en: A human civilization outside the ordinary rule of the gods and the Seven. Its fall involved multiple factions and an unresolved causal sequence; it is not synonymous with the Abyss.
description.ru: Человеческая цивилизация вне обычной власти богов и Семерых. Её падение связано с несколькими группами и невыясненной цепью причин; она не тождественна Бездне.

notes.en: Imported from the supplied research pack, not independently checked against game transcripts. Russian labels are editorial translations unless supplied by the pack or already established in this archive; exact official localization and game version require review.
